description: Schedule an existing DRAFT campaign for delivery at a specific ISO-8601 datetime. IMPORTANT: this is a DESTRUCTIVE action — the campaign will be queued for sending to real contacts. You MUST set confirmed=true in the call, which requires explicit user consent. Call nevent_get_campaign first to verify the draft content and recipient segment. scheduled_time must be in the future (ISO-8601, e.g. 2025-06-01T10:00:00Z). The campaign transitions from DRAFT to SCHEDULED status on success.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to schedule (must be in DRAFT status)

confirmed.description: Must be the literal value true to proceed. Set confirmed=true to confirm you want to schedule this campaign for sending.

scheduled_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime for scheduled send (must be in the future). Example: "2026-05-01T10:00:00Z" or "2026-05-01T10:00:00+02:00"

name: nevent_schedule_campaign
